name: Commit digest
description: Every weekday at 9:00, read the last 5 commits of feat-cmux-next, have Claude write a 3-line digest, and save it on the team machine.

steps.prompt: Write a digest of these commits for the team channel: exactly 3 lines, each starting with '- '. Plain text, no preamble.

steps.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/digests" && f="$HOME/digests/$CMUX_RUN.txt" && cat > "$f" && echo "saved $(wc -l < "$f") lines to $f"
